principles: Preserve separate Drill Session and Skill Seminar dose generators.
Preserve tier-adjusted latent-coordinate plus nonlinear marginal-cost response as a working response family, not a game constant.
Treat within-preview allocation lambda_i as a possible variable; default to 1 only where no replicated evidence supports a deviation.
Separate central-gain calibration from preview-interval rendering.
Do not promote conversation-ordered tests into the immutable timestamp-sealed run log using invented timestamps.

hypotheses.evidence: Darren age19 Standard Skill Seminar x23 versus earlier x33, same player/programme/p but different affected stat identities.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched same-player, same affected-stat set, same p Skill Seminar multiplier contrast outside the admitted dose-ratio range.

hypotheses.evidence: Willie Ferguson age21 Focused Defending x20 Skill Seminar p=1: predicted Positioning [60,78], observed [86,101]. Holding the rest of that predictor fixed gives 0.70*(93.5/69) ≈ 0.95.
hypotheses.boundary: This is conditional on the rest of the predictor; it is not an independently identified source-game coefficient.
hypotheses.falsifier: Additional p=1 Focused Skill Seminar observations calibrated under the same response surface consistently require a materially different scale.

hypotheses.evidence: Willie Ferguson Reward Focused Defending x4 p=2: Tackling 89 -> [14,19], Marking 111 -> [10,14]. Endpoint ratios 14/10=1.40 and 19/14=1.36 despite both being WHITE and in the candidate low-cost region.
hypotheses.boundary: Do not generalise these weights to all Tackling/Marking or all Reward sessions.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched repeats on the same or comparable state show equal allocations within display tolerance.

hypotheses.evidence: Transferring the age19 Howden x33 Standard Skill Seminar calibration to age21 Ferguson x33 produced point estimates inside all four actual intervals but mostly high relative to observed midpoints.
hypotheses.boundary: Player identity, stat mix/class, role and interval renderer all differ; age is not isolated.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched same-player age transition or stronger cross-player controls remove the residual without an age term.

hypotheses.evidence: Ferguson x33 central predictions were strong (4/4 points inside observed) while interval edges were systematically high; Darren x23 showed the same central-versus-width distinction.
hypotheses.testPlan: Fit central latent gain first, then calibrate low/high interval offsets or width as a distinct quantisation/renderer layer.

nextTests: Same player, same affected stats, Standard Skill Seminar at two multipliers to isolate q_skill.
Same player, p=1 Standard versus Focused Skill Seminar at matched N to isolate focused_skill_scale.
Repeat Willie Ferguson Reward Focused Defending x4 p=2, or a same-state sibling session, to test Tackling/Marking allocation replication.
Age 19 versus 21 controls with matched programme/N/p/stat/class to test whether the current broad age band should become a smooth decline.
Record every future prediction before player selection in a timestamped repository or app log so it can enter the immutable prospective-holdout pipeline.
